component.name: Servitor
component.summary: Monitor NVIDIA GPUs on remote servers over SSH

description.p: Servitor watches NVIDIA GPUs across remote servers over SSH, and on the machine it runs on, from a single window. Each server shows how many of its GPUs are occupied, their temperature and memory, and which processes are holding them.
Nothing is installed on the monitored machines: it needs only SSH access and the nvidia-smi binary that ships with the driver.
